headlines.title: Bahamas ambassador calls for regional emergencyexercises and greater investment in technology and training
Eleuthera wide project pledges 1,000 Bahamian jobs from launch
Bahamas Education, Science and Technology (BEST) Foundation Announces Inaugural Board of Directors and Interim Executive Director
The Governor General serves as patron at ‘The Longest Table’ in The Bahamas
Bahamas Signs Education Cooperation Agreement with Uruguay’s Fundación Ceibal

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Bahamas ambassador calls for regional emergency exercises and greater investment in technology and training. [1]
The Eleuthera wide project pledges 1,000 Bahamian jobs from launch. [2]

KEY RISKS
Bahamas is linked to 2 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the Eleuthera wide project will deliver the pledged 1,000 Bahamian jobs from launch. [2]
Whether the Bahamas Education, Science and Technology (BEST) Foundation will implement its inaugural board and interim executive director's plans. [3]
